walking_policy.source: 2026-10-18 robot runs 1018d (walk61 0.25 m/s, 3 s, clean twice), guide/firmware/mac/robot-runs-20261018/README.md
candidates: runtime-overlay/models-ft3-it999 (ft3 iteration 999, D-017): sim-better; on the robot 2026-10-17 and 2026-10-18 (three walks at 0.20 m/s, guide/firmware/mac/robot-runs-20261018) it lost balance at 2.5-4 s every time, while walk61 at 0.25 m/s for 3 s walked and stopped cleanly twice

runtime-overlay/models-t1-best (Kaggle run t1 iteration 800, 2026-10-30, fork cmu/finetune/modal/FINETUNE-DELTA.md 'Run t1'): walk61 fine-tuned so the body follows the head; as-built sim: walks 0.95-1.16 m in 6 s at vx 0.25 with the neck at -0.8..-0.1 (walk61: 7 mm, it stops stepping under any head command) and holds the neck within 0.09 rad standing after a step; suite real cases no falls and more distance, but peak tilt 3-4 deg higher and 5-27 action jumps per 10 s against walk61's 0-10 (ft3's pattern before it fell on the robot). Robot 2026-10-30 10:27-10:29 (guide/firmware/mac/robot-runs-20261030-t1): the neck follows on the robot (command -0.4 -> -0.38..-0.42 walking; -0.8 -> -0.70..-0.92 walking and -0.816 held 10 s standing after the walk, walk61: -0.09), but the plain 0.25 m/s walk fell sideways at 3.4 s and all three walks peaked at 13.8-29 deg tilt with 17-22 action jumps over 0.5 rad per s, against walk61's 7.4-8.6 deg and 1.4-2.7 per s on the same robot. Slow walks 11:00 (same folder): 0.10 m/s with neck -0.4 stayed up but jumped 13.5 per s and tilted 15.5 deg at the stop; 0.15 m/s with neck -0.8 fell at 2.7 s (held 11 deg roll, then pitched forward). Not deployable at any tested speed; walk61 stays deployed

runtime-overlay/models-t2b-best (Kaggle run t2b iteration 850, 2026-10-30, fork cmu/finetune/modal/FINETUNE-DELTA.md 'Run t2'): T1 plus a behaviour-cloning anchor to walk61. Action distance from walk61 on walk61's own robot walks 0.221 rad (T1 0.711, gate 0.25); as-built sim (plugged): neck -0.4 -> -0.367 and -0.8 -> -0.686 walking at vx 0.25 (0.56-0.59 m in 6 s; walk61's plain walk 0.45 m), suite real cases 2-4 action jumps per 10 s (T1 5-27, walk61 1-3), drop8_imu35 falls 1 of 6 seeds (walk61 0, T1 3). Fails the t2 plan's G2 (neck -0.8 off 0.114 > 0.10) and G3 (drop8 seed 0 fall; vx0.25 4 jumps > 3); Shawn waived both for a robot test on 2026-10-30. Robot test 2026-10-30 16:00-16:02 (guide/firmware/mac/robot-runs-20261030-t1/t2b/README.md): default-head walk at 0.25 like walk61 (8.7 deg peak, 1.7 action jumps per s), but with a neck command it shakes like T1 (neck -0.4: 16.4 deg, 14 jumps per s; neck -0.8: 10.8 deg, 13.6 per s; standing neck -0.64 against -0.8). No fall. Not deployable; walk61 stays deployed

runtime-overlay/models-t3b-best (Kaggle run t3b iteration 900, 2026-10-30, fork cmu/finetune/modal/FINETUNE-DELTA.md 'Run t3 progress'): t2b plus the jitter study's sim gap in the training DR (BAM friction 1.0-1.4, gyro noise proportional to leg speed), an action second-difference penalty (-0.58), and the anchor extended to head-command states (walk61's leg actions on the head-zeroed state). Action distance from walk61 on walk61's robot walks 0.239 rad (gate 0.25). Calibrated jitter sim (gyro dq 0.25, friction 1.4; the setting that reproduced the 10/30 robot rows within 2x): neck -0.4 2.3 action jumps per s, neck -0.8 5.1, no fall in 9 rows (t2b 11.0 / 11.5 with 2 falls of 6, T1 17-21 all fallen), but the neck stops at -0.25 for -0.4 and -0.44 for -0.8 (t2b reaches -0.40..-0.44 and -0.72..-0.76 there) and peak tilt at -0.8 is 13-15 deg (gate 12). drop8_imu35 0 of 6 falls (walk61 0, t2b 1, T1 3); plugged suite real cases no fall, 0-2 action jumps, but 10-30 % shorter walks than walk61. Fails the t3 plan's G2 (neck depth, -0.8 tilt) and G3 (distance); not robot-tested; walk61 stays deployed. t3a (anchor on default-head states only) fell in the head-command rows, as its design predicted.
